text.text: Cisco Integrated System for Microsoft Azure Stack

graphic.text: Cisco Integrated System for Microsoft Azure Stack

text.text: The Cisco Integrated System for Microsoft Azure Stack is a co-engineered solutions that enables you to run the Azure public cloud within your datacenter. This enables the user to see the same user interface as if they were using the Azure Public Cloud, while the developer can exercise the same Application Programming Interfaces (APIs) for Azure Stack as they would for Azure. Customers who have data sovereignty, regulatory, connection latency, or heritage application issues should consider the advantages that the Cisco Integrated System for Microsoft Azure Stack provides.

text.text: The two Nexus 9000 are the top of rack switches which enable connectivity to your data center’s border switches. Currently, Microsoft support a direct point to point L3 connectivity with a choice of with BGP or Static Routing for the protocol. Each switch maintains a copy of the configuration of the other switch to enable quick replacement should a failure occur. Nexus continues to be the standard for network connectivity in data centers around the world. The Cisco Nexus 93180LC-EX Switch supports: 3.6 Tbps of bandwidth in a 1 RU form factor 24 fixed 40/50-Gbps QSFP+ ports 6 fixed 40/100-Gbps QSFP28 for uplink connectivity Latency of less than 1 microsecond Port-side exhaust and port-side intake airflow configurations 1+1 redundant hot-swappable 80 Plus Platinum-certified power supplies Hot swappable 3+1 redundant fan trays

text.text: The two third generation Fabric Interconnect hosts the UCS Manager systems management software that monitors each element below the Top of Rack switch and can feed this information to the Azure Stack Azure Admin Portal. The full complement of UCS Manager capabilities are available to customers including Cisco’s ground breaking Service Profile capability which is extremely useful when adding a server node to a cluster. Cluster Management 26 40Gb Ethernet/FCoE ports 6 40Gb Ethernet/FCoE ports Redundant, hot swappable 650W power supplies Redundant, hot swappable fans Serial ports

text.text: The Cisco Integrated System for Microsoft Azure Stack can scale from 4 to 16 servers in increments of one within a scale unit (cluster). Thus, you only purchase the exact amount of server capacity you require be it for example 7 nodes. In the near future, you can add any number of servers to an installed Azure Stack to reach a total of 16 per cluster. The server hosts the Azure Stack infrastructure software as well as all of the Azure services you are consuming each running within a virtual machine. 2 x Intel Xeon E5 V4 gen CPU (Choice of 6 options 12 to 22 core) 256GB, 512 GB, or 768GB DDR4 Memory (Choice of 3 memory capacity) 40GbE NIC 2 x 3.2 TB NVMe cards 8 x 8 TB 12G SAS 7.2k RPM LFF HDD (4k) 1 X SAS 12G HBA 2 x 480GB 2.5 inch Boot SSD (Raid 1) TPM 2.0 Note: Each server must be configured exactly the same.
